description: This file is an implementation of the EmailCampaignReadPlatformService interface in a Java-based project. It provides methods to retrieve email campaign and business rule data from a database using JDBC, including fetching individual campaigns, all campaigns, scheduled campaigns, and related business rules. It uses Spring's JdbcTemplate for database interactions and defines internal mappers for converting ResultSet rows into domain objects.

classes.name: EmailCampaignMapper
classes.description: Maps ResultSet rows to EmailCampaignData objects, selecting specific columns related to email campaigns and associated reports.

classes.name: BusinessRuleMapper
classes.description: Extracts data about email business rules from ResultSet, assembling a list of EmailBusinessRulesData objects with nested parameters.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Retrieves all email business rules with report type 'Email'.

methods.name: retrieveOneTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves a single email business rule template by its report ID.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Retrieves an email campaign by its ID.

methods.name: retrieveAllScheduleActiveCampaign
methods.description: Retrieves all active scheduled email campaigns.
